budget_contract.ceiling_interpretation: authorization ceilings, not measured provider billing

limitations: host-networked provider CLIs; execution is not hermetic
synthetic development episodes are not held-out external validation
intervals condition on this generator and equal family weights; they do not include model rerun variability or simulator misspecification
provider spend outside Claude's assignment cap is unbounded
complete agent-system outcomes are not isolated base-model scores
provider usage, cost, and signed request receipts are not yet captured by this development runner
local HMAC checkpoints, a public progress watermark, and a host-global lock are not an external rollback-resistant ledger

provider output capture is bounded, but this macOS development runner enforces no aggregate provider RSS, filesystem-byte or file-count, process-count, or OS-job ceiling; original-process-group containment is not full job containment

profiles.requested_reasoning: model default; Cursor exposes no reasoning tier

run_contract.orphan_policy: seal started assignment as transport_void; never retry; block cohort completion and every later provider call
run_contract.primary_estimand: fixed 50-episode mean per profile only with zero transport voids
run_contract.provider_process_policy: new POSIX session; bounded output capture; terminate and verify the original process group before continuing; detached processes that close inherited pipes remain outside this development runner's containment guarantee
run_contract.retry_policy: at most one provider invocation per assignment

terminal_incident_policy.codex_authentication_boundary: record only after durable model_invocation start or an explicit Codex credential-state incident
terminal_incident_policy.effects: seal the current assignment as transport_void; never retry; call no later provider; block cohort retirement, terminal completion, and private trace release

provider_state_persistence_guard_failure.post_quiescence_codex_authentication_sta: not ambiguous after successful provider-process, supervisor-boundary, and credential attestations

run_contract.transport_void_policy: ordinary cleanly quiesced void ends only that provider assignment and the same still-running supervised evaluator continues with the next assignment without a second outer launch; crash-orphan, provider process or state isolation, episode-service cleanup, and Codex authentication incidents are terminal and non-resumable
